stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Is ONE Stolen Base From the 40-40 Club

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
ONE stolen base.

That's all Pete Crow-Armstrong needs to join the 40-40 club — one of only 6 players in MLB history to ever do it.

He has 39. The Cubs have 3 games left. The whole baseball world is watching. ⚾ #Cubs #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
PCA check: 45+ HRs. 39 SBs. One steal from history.

Canseco. Bonds. A-Rod. Soriano. Acuña. Ohtani.

Pete Crow-Armstrong is one play from joining that list. At age 24. In the middle of a wild card race.

No big deal. #Cubs #MLB
